researcher_notes: CALIBRATION RUN. NEW SUPPLIER CANDIDATE -- 'Enabled Robotics ApS' does not match any of the 38 companies currently in the DB (checked by normalized name against the pre-flight snapshot; no partial-name overlap either). HQ address printed on the brochure: Agerhatten 27A, Entrance 4, DK-5220 Odense SØ, Denmark. Two files describe the ER-FLEX product family: 'er-flex-brochure-2024_digital.pdf' (5pp marketing brochure, covers the base 'ER-FLEX 250 series') and 'er-flex-max-specifications-sheet-with-cable.pdf' (1pp technical spec sheet for a distinct, larger sibling product 'ER-FLEX-MAX'). These are NOT the same product despite sharing the ER-FLEX name and platform/software (ER-ABILITY) -- weight (161-174kg vs 460kg), transport payload (up to 186kg vs 380kg), IP rating (IP20 vs IP52/IP54) and cobot-arm options (UR5e/UR10e/UR16e vs UR20/UR30) all differ substantially, so two separate product entries were created rather than one grouped extraction. Both are mobile bases with a collaborative robot arm on top -- classified as Mobile AMR per the industry README (light-to-moderate payload, SLAM-based auto-mapped navigation, no standard floor pallet pickup; it is a pick-and-place/machine-tending cobot on wheels, not a fork/pallet handler). integration_capability is genuinely richer for the base ER-FLEX (its brochure explicitly names ERP/WES/MES/WMS/REST/OPC-UA) than what is restated on the one-page ER-FLEX-MAX spec sheet (which only explicitly lists REST/OPC-UA) -- since both run the same ER-ABILITY software platform the broader integration list is very likely also true for ER-FLEX-MAX, but per this agent's source-grounding rule I only recorded what each file itself states and flagged the likely broader applicability in ER-FLEX-MAX's notes rather than assuming it.

products.notes: Company-level field country='DK' (ISO 3166) can be derived from the printed HQ address 'DK-5220 Odense SØ, Denmark' -- recorded at company level in the company_wide_context-adjacent note here since this findings schema scopes 'fields' per product; import script should also set Company.country='DK' for Enabled Robotics ApS. lift_height intentionally left null (not 0): the ER-FLEX is a fixed-arm-height mobile cobot base, not a lifting-type AMR -- there is no stated lift function, so null (unknown/not-applicable) is used rather than 0, consistent with Blank ≠ Zero. Vehicle dimension figures appear on the p.4 diagram (357/840/517/364/800/580 mm) but are unlabeled callout numbers on an image without a legend in the extracted text -- NOT used for vehicle_length/vehicle_width to avoid misattributing an unlabeled number to the wrong field; a page-image read of the labelled diagram could resolve this in a future pass if precise footprint is needed. battery_type intentionally left null: 'Battery 34.2 Ah / 1.63 kWh' capacity is stated but chemistry (Li-Ion etc.) is never named on this brochure. autonomous_charging intentionally left null: brochure says only 'smart charging' without confirming autonomous docking.

products.notes: Sibling of 'ER-FLEX' (250 series) documented in the same session from 'er-flex-brochure-2024_digital.pdf' -- that brochure states broader integration_capability (ERP/WMS/MES in addition to REST/OPC-UA) for the same ER-ABILITY software platform, which very likely also applies to ER-FLEX-MAX, but this one-page MAX spec sheet itself only explicitly names REST and OPC-UA -- recorded conservatively per-source rather than assumed; reviewer may want to add ERP/WMS/MES here too after confirming with the vendor. navigation_type here is limited to 'Vision' (explicitly stated on this sheet); SLAM/auto-mapping is documented for the base ER-FLEX brochure but not explicitly restated on this MAX spec sheet, so not added here to stay strictly source-grounded per file. Laser Scanners ('Detects objects from afar, 360°') and Proximity sensors are safety features, not navigation, and have no direct AP0 field mapping beyond what functional_safety_level/safety_standard would need (neither of which is stated with an explicit PL/SIL rating or named standard, so both left null).
